answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of agents for a liveness check, like a gale arriving without warning. A chosen agent has 90 seconds to return a compute heartbeat: a fresh signal of real work, bound to a beacon nonce. Two misses slash the 50-credit stake and strand it as an island no peer attests. 1,000 fakes face 50 checks per epoch and lose 2,500 credits per round, while an honest agent stakes 50 credits once and keeps full rewards.
